title: We Left None Alive
text: When you play this condition, you may spot a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man to place 2 <symbol>rohan</symbol> tokens here. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition or remove a <symbol>rohan</symbol> token from here to make a <symbol>rohan</symbol> Man skirmishing an exhausted minion strength +2.
